video.title: I Asked AI for a Money-Making Website (It Built One in Minutes)

summary: Chris Koerner uses Abacus ChatLLM to pit AI models against each other in choosing a directory niche. He picks an estate cleanout directory after checking Google Trends, has models compile and cross-check 20 Dallas-Fort Worth estate cleanout businesses, and uses the Abacus agent to build and deploy a searchable directory with $30/month Stripe featured listings in minutes. He explains monetisation through featured placement, banner ads and lead auctions, a niche-versus-geography rule, and why estate cleanouts are a negative-COGS business. The video is sponsored by Abacus.

ideas.name: Estate cleanout directory website (Estate Cleanout Pros)
ideas.one_liner: AI-built nationwide directory of estate sale cleanout businesses, pre-filled from AI research, monetised with $30/month Stripe featured listings, banner ads and resold leads.
ideas.business_model: Paid featured listings, banner ads, lead sales
ideas.customer: Families (often millennial children of boomers) needing estate cleanouts; cleanout businesses paying for placement
ideas.problem: Grieving, time-pressed families want a trusted shortlist rather than vetting 15 companies; junk removal feels disrespectful
ideas.offer: Searchable directory with category and listing pages, free submission and paid featured placement

pricing.notes: Listings added without permission for free; businesses pay only for top placement.

acquisition_channels.details: Niche directory pages; Google Trends showed 'estate cleanout' rising.
Directories as sources for AI answers.

ideas.delivery: Abacus ChatLLM agent builds and deploys the site; models compile and fact-check listings; Stripe for payments; admin panel.

acquisition.how: SEO inbound for consumers. Selling featured listings or leads to businesses by email: UK PECR allows cold email to limited companies only, not sole traders, who make up many cleanout firms.

delivery.how: Directory runs passively once built; listings need periodic AI refresh and verification.

support.how: Listing disputes and lead quality complaints.

uk_applicability.notes: Directory model works in the UK (house clearance firms); UK GDPR applies to listing sole traders' personal details and to lead resale. Lead sales by email to limited companies only under PECR.

risks: Takes time to rank in SEO

tactics.name: Multi-model niche selection
steps: Ask several models the same prompt for an underserved directory niche
Validate with Google Trends using the right buyer-intent term (e.g. 'estate cleanout', not 'estate sale')

quote.text: What's an underserved local directory niche I could build and monetize?
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: AI-built directory in an hour
steps: Prompt a model to compile 20 real businesses with name, category, phone, description in a table
Regenerate with other models; fact-check with a different model
Ask an agent to build a searchable directory with category/listing pages and Stripe featured upgrade
Deploy, add AI hero image, check admin panel
Scale to 1,000+ nationwide listings by telling the model how much work to do

tactics.name: Niche vs geography rule
steps: If the industry is very niche, go broad on geography
If geography is narrow, keep the industry broad
Go niche on both only with enough search demand

quote.text: If the industry is very niche, then the geography should be more broad
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Directory monetisation stack
steps: Charge for featured placement once they get leads
Capture consumer leads yourself and auction to listed businesses by email

quote.text: Hey, I have this lead. It's in this neighborhood. We think it's worth this much. Who wants it?
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Positioning by name
steps: Name the business for the niche you want (Estate Cleanout Pros) to own it, accepting you lose adjacent work

lessons.lesson: Negative-COGS businesses get paid to acquire inventory.

'Token maxing' (using top models for everything) builds prompting skill.
Consumer niches are easier to reach; B2B niches pay more.
